items.title: Warren "Baby" Dodds Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: I actually liked Jimmy. I liked to work for him. ... I was to go to California with Jimmy. ... When he, when he went there. About 1941 or two or something?

ctx.x: Now I can see what a good guy he was. What type of band do you think he enjoyed working in most? The bigger band or the smaller groups? He worked so many smaller groups. Was that by choice or was it just because they usually only hired three or four? That's all they were hired. Because he knew he could get as much out of the three or four men and he couldn't win five or six. He couldn't get the harmony, but there was work the man got. That's why we got the band of the Hot Seven. And that band put out the work of…
